pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 2...Nc6 3.Bb5 Nd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 exchanged with Bxd4 or Bxc6, captures the b5-bishop cannot make. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, Grand Prix, 3...g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.Bb5 Nd4
pages.notes: Plans recaptured on d4 with the e-pawn (only the c-pawn can) and wrote the queen lift as Qe1-h4 before castling. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, Grand Prix, 3...g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.Bb5 Nd4 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the queen lift as one route; plan 2 named ...b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview and plan 4. Plan 3 (a pin that isn't one) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-11 (reviewer: first draft retreated the bishop to d3 and then played d3).

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, Grand Prix, 3...g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.Bc4 e6
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a knight via d1-e3 as a single route. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 3.g3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a knight 'to d5 via f1-e3'. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e5 7.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 used a Qe1-h4 lift through White's own g3-pawn with the king uncastled; plan 4 traded the g7-bishop via ...Bh6 'for a knight'. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e5 7.Nf3 Nge7
pages.notes: Overview called it a Stonewall set-up; plan 1 used a Qe1-h4 lift through the g3-pawn. Rewrote overview and plan 1. Plan 2 (a ...d5 break that isn't this line's idea) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-11 (reviewer: first draft said both knights control d4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e6
pages.notes: Plan 3 used a Qe1-h4 lift through the g3-pawn and called f5 an outpost (Black's e6- and g6-pawns cover it); plan 4 rerouted the e7-knight to c8 or g8 for no clear reason. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e6: 9.Be3 Nd4 10.e5
pages.notes: Plan 3 gave Black ...Nf6, which no knight can reach; the main reply is ...Nef5. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e6: 9.Be3 Nd4 10.e5 Nef5
pages.notes: Plan 1 retreated the attacked e3-bishop with Bf1 (it is the g2-bishop that stands next to f1) and pushed f5 onto Black's knight. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nf3 e6 6.Be3
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-7: plan 3 recaptured with Nxd4 before ...cxd4. Rewrote plan 3 (reviewer: the first draft's 'stable edge' could not be confirmed).

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...e5
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-7: plan 2 named d4 as a Black move. Rewrote plan 2 (reviewer: the first draft had ...Nf6 controlling d4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.g3
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-8: plan 2 supported the knight with ...c6 while the c-pawn stands on c5. Rewrote plan 2 (reviewer: the first draft kept an unconfirmed ...b5-b4 idea).
